segments.sn19.4:1.1: “Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ nicchaviṃ purisaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ.
segments.sn19.4:1.2: Tamenaṃ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti.
segments.sn19.4:1.3: So sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … pe … eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃyeva rājagahe orabbhiko ahosi … pe ….
